backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user profiles, and product/order/export inquiry management with initial catalog creation and in‑memory maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, associated files, components, and test IDs for recent UI and logo updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose across components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, theme variables, and dark‑mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React routing setup with language‑prefixed routes, layout, providers, and initial catalog creation trigger.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Logo component displaying the generated PNG with bounce animation keyed by routing transitions.
frontend/src/components/ExportInquiryFor: Form component for submitting export inquiries with validation, optional auto‑translation, and inline success handling.
frontend/src/components/LangLink.tsx: Empty file placeholder for a language‑aware link component.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown to switch app language, updating state and URL prefix on selection.
frontend/src/components/OwnerGate.tsx: Gate component that restricts access to owner-only areas and toggles owner mode.
frontend/src/components/ProcessPicture.t: Displays a product's process image with fallback placeholder and size variants.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card showing image, category, name, description, price, and link to details.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with company info, links, social icons, and WhatsApp contact.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Site header with logo, navigation, language selector, cart link, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper including header, footer, and main content slot.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: React context managing cart state with add, update, remove, and persistence to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing backend actors based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useExportInquiry.ts: Mutation hook sending export inquiry data via actor and refreshing inquiry queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity auth flow, stored identities, and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogoBounceKey.ts: Provides a key that increments on route changes to trigger animation remounts.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Defines a mutation hook to place orders via the actor and invalidate the orders query.
frontend/src/hooks/useOwnerContact.ts: Returns owner contact data and updates it when localStorage or custom events change.
frontend/src/hooks/useOwnerData.ts: Provides queries for fetching all orders and export inquiries from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides product-related queries including all products, products by category, and categories.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: Implements a language context with geo-IP detection, persistence, and document-level language settings.
frontend/src/i18n/strings.ts: Contains centralized English UI strings used as the base for translations.
frontend/src/i18n/useT.ts: Provides translation hooks using react-query to fetch translated UI strings and dynamic text.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme variables, dark mode, RTL support, and base styles.
frontend/src/lib/cart.ts: Utility functions for managing cart items including add, update, remove, and totals.
frontend/src/lib/geoIp.ts: Provides geo-IP country detection and normalization using public APIs.
frontend/src/lib/i18nRouting.ts: Utilities for parsing, stripping, adding, and switching language prefixes in routes.
frontend/src/lib/language.ts: Defines supported languages, mappings, persistence helpers, and lookup utilities.
frontend/src/lib/ownerContact.ts: Manages owner contact details with validation, localStorage persistence, and update events.
frontend/src/lib/ownerMode.ts: Provides helpers to enable, disable, and check owner mode via localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/processPictures.ts: Maps backend product process image filenames to local generated asset paths with safe fallback for missing values.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deeplClient: Implements a DeepL translation request wrapper with optional API key handling and graceful fallbacks.
frontend/src/lib/translation/translation: Provides an in-memory and sessionStorage-backed cache for translated text with expiration and size limits.
High-level translation functions using DeepL and caching, including batch translation and language code mapping.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart UI with item management, totals, and navigation to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles order submission with a customer info form, validation, cart data mapping, and navigation to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/ExportInquiryPage.tsx: Displays an export inquiry form and a success screen after submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the marketing homepage with hero section, product highlights, and contact options.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows order confirmation details including order ID and navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/OwnerPage.tsx: Owner dashboard page showing orders and export inquiries with detail dialogs and contact settings.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Product detail view fetching a product by ID, displaying info, and allowing add-to-cart with quantity control.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Shop page listing products with category-based filtering and tab navigation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and content paths.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the multilingual ecommerce site, architectural notes, issues, and feature records.
